rule_reference: planning P2-3: forward phase is research observation only, no real orders; every decision records the data snapshot hash visible at the time, signal observation time, target weights, simulated submit/confirm/value dates, matched rule version, estimated and verifiable actual fees, rejections/purchase limits/deferrals, target vs actual simulated holding deviation, and daily NAV with attribution.

required_fields.decision_date: ISO date of the simulated decision
required_fields.parameter_freeze_id: frozen parameter set id used for this decision
required_fields.data_snapshot_sha256: hash of the data snapshot visible at signal observation time
required_fields.signal_observed_at: ISO timestamp when the signal was observed
required_fields.target_weights: dict of fund_code to target weight summing to 1
required_fields.rule_version_id: trading rule version matched on submit date
required_fields.estimated_fees: number, estimated fees for this decision
required_fields.actual_fees: number, verifiable actual fees from shadow order records
required_fields.target_vs_actual_deviation: max absolute weight deviation target vs actual simulated holdings
